original_benchmark.notes: PRBench Finance (Scale AI, arXiv 2511.11562): expert-written conversations graded against weighted rubric criteria by an LLM judge (o4-mini in the paper). finance_hard (300) is a subset of these records.
PRBench Legal. legal_hard (250) is a subset of these records.

harbor_adapter.notes: Oracle run (ORACLE_MODE=true) and nop run cover all 1100 tasks. Parity on a 200-task subset (--split parity), 100 per domain, stratified by hard-subset membership and topic: runs 1 and 2 of 3 done, run ranges overlap on both domains and overall. parity_costs is an upper bound for runs 1 and 2 (the endpoint's total usage over the two runs).
